author: Abby Kyriakoutsakos Marrazzo
text:
The first few days you really need to double check. Also, it may be a compression low. 

If you move around a bit — swing your arm — I bet it will go right back up. Also remember that it is behind your blood glucose meter by about 15 minutes.
